edits.before: - Bard Cosmic Binding: matchup-defining — The wall-stun starts every Bard pick — never hug terrain near him. It writes your spacing rules. - E Unbreakable is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
